project_identity.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC FINTECH (Monarch & Nubank Inspired)
project_identity.design_goal: Modernize legacy Angular app into a sleek React financial command center with high clarity, precise visual hierarchy, tabular numeric alignment, and interactive analytics.
project_identity.theme_mode: Light default with subtle warm slate tinting, high contrast for numbers, and full Dark mode toggle support.

typography.numeric_font: JetBrains Mono, Roboto Mono, monospace (with tabular-nums)

scale.hero_kpi: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight tabular-nums

rules: Always apply `tabular-nums` class to money figures, currency tables, chart tooltips, and transaction amounts to avoid horizontal layout jitter.
Main titles must use bold weight with `tracking-tight`.
Overlines and table column headers must be uppercase `text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider text-slate-500`.
FORBIDDEN COLOR: #1B93A4 (teal green) is forbidden for primary dashboard background.
Borders must be subtle 1px `#E2E8F0` (light mode) or `#1F2937` (dark mode) to keep clean cardless/thin-card aesthetic.

sidebar.type: Fixed collapsible desktop sidebar with mobile drawer sheet
sidebar.header: Account Switcher Dropdown (select multiple financial accounts or 'All Accounts')

layout_and_navigation.page_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6

home_overview.kpi_cards: 3 main stat cards: Total Income (green icon), Total Expenses (red icon), Net Balance (blue/emerald icon) with trend indicators vs previous period.
home_overview.charts: Grid layout: Left col-span-2 line chart ('Expenses grouped by category'), Right col-span-1 bar chart ('Income vs Expenses history').

transactions_view.month_summary_header: Sticky top bar showing Opening Balance + Net Income = Total Closing Balance for the selected month.
transactions_view.filters: Search text filter, Month/Year picker, Category selector, Tag multi-select.
transactions_view.list_styling: Grouped by month/day. Rows show Payee avatar, Category badge, Tags chips, Comment popover, Amount formatted as `+ R$ 250,00` (green) or `- R$ 85,50` (red).

distribution_view.doughnut_chart: Recharts PieChart/Doughnut with inner radius cutout, showing spending per category.
distribution_view.drill_down: Interactive list on the right allowing users to click a category to drill into its subcategories with progress breakdown.

history_and_analysis_views.history: Combined Bar + Line chart tracking monthly income/expense bars and cumulative balance line over 12 months.
history_and_analysis_views.monthly_analysis: Per-week line chart with month/year picker.
history_and_analysis_views.month_comparison: Side-by-side comparison matrix of two selectable months by category.

budgets.budget_cards: Grid of budget cards with circular progress or linear progress bar (% spent), total budgeted, spent, remaining, and category tags included.
budgets.create_edit_modal: Shadcn Dialog with inputs for budget name, target amount, assigned categories, and period.

parties_and_debts.split_view: Left panel: Searchable list of payees/debtors with net balance sum. Right panel: Detailed transaction history filtered by selected party.

planning_calendar.calendar: Grid or calendar view of scheduled/planned recurring payments. Paid items highlighted in emerald green badge, unpaid in crimson red badge.
planning_calendar.actions: 'Copy to next month' batch button and 'Clean-up completed' action.

import_export.dropzone: Drag-and-drop zone for uploading JSON transaction files, with validation preview table before committing.

settings.danger_zone: Card with red border for 'Delete All Transactions' requiring confirmation modal.

testing_guidelines.rule: Every interactive button, input, tab, dropdown trigger, and chart container MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, popovers, or modals. Use blur backdrop with non-zero opacity (e.g. `bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md` or `bg-slate-900/90`).
Do NOT center align the app container. Maintain clean left-aligned functional dashboard grids.
Use `tabular-nums` for all monetary numbers and tables.
Always provide micro-hover feedback on interactive cards, table rows, and buttons using Tailwind scale transitions.
Ensure all forms use controlled React state or react-hook-form + zod validation.
Add `data-testid` to all functional components as specified in testing guidelines.
